parameters.jsCode:
// ====== DEMO CONFIG – move secrets to n8n Credentials before production ======
const PRODUCT_GROUPS = {
  // group name           : terms matched (case-insensitive) in KEV vendor/product, NVD CPE/description, article text
  "Microsoft":            ["Microsoft","Windows","Exchange","SharePoint","Office","Entra","Azure","Intune","Hyper-V","SQL Server","Teams","OneDrive","Outlook","Defender"],
  "Fortinet":             ["Fortinet","FortiGate","FortiOS","FortiManager","FortiAnalyzer","FortiClient"],
  "ConnectWise":          ["ConnectWise","ScreenConnect"],
  "NinjaOne":             ["NinjaOne","Ninja RMM"],
  "Cisco":                ["Cisco"],
  "Ivanti":               ["Ivanti"],
  "Citrix":               ["Citrix","NetScaler"],
  "VMware":               ["VMware","Broadcom"],
  "Veeam":                ["Veeam"],
  "SonicWall":            ["SonicWall"],
  "Palo Alto":            ["Palo Alto","PAN-OS","GlobalProtect"],
  "Apple":                ["Apple","iOS","macOS"],
  "Google / Chrome":      ["Google","Chrome","Chromium"],
  "Mozilla":              ["Mozilla","Firefox"],
  "Adobe":                ["Adobe","Acrobat"],
  "Atlassian":            ["Atlassian","Confluence","Jira"],
  "Oracle":               ["Oracle"],
  "SolarWinds":           ["SolarWinds"],
  "ManageEngine":         ["Zoho","ManageEngine"],
  "NAS":                  ["Synology","QNAP"],
  "Ubiquiti":             ["Ubiquiti","UniFi"],
  "Hardware OEM":         ["Dell","Lenovo"],
  "Progress / MOVEit":    ["Progress","MOVEit"],
  "DevOps":               ["GitLab","Jenkins"],
  "Linux / OSS":          ["OpenSSL","Linux","Ubuntu","Samba"],
  "PaperCut":             ["PaperCut"],
  "Kaseya":               ["Kaseya"],
  "Security tools":       ["CrowdStrike","Proofpoint","ThreatLocker","Auvik"],
  "Archivers":            ["7-Zip","WinRAR"],
  "Proxmox":              ["Proxmox"],
};
return [{
  json: {
    SUPABASE_URL: "https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co",
    SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY: "YOUR-SERVICE-ROLE-KEY",      // server-side only, never in the dashboard
    TEAMS_WEBHOOK: "https://YOUR-TENANT.webhook.office.com/webhookb2/....",
    DASHBOARD_URL: "https://your-dashboard-url/",      // linked at the bottom of every email/card
    EMAIL_TO: "you@example.com",                       // comma-separated list for the team digest
    EMAIL_FROM: "Threat Intel <you@gmail.com>",        // must match the SMTP credential account

    PRODUCT_GROUPS,
    VENDOR_ALLOWLIST: Object.values(PRODUCT_GROUPS).flat(),

    // High-signal phrases for news scoring (weight added to score)
    SIGNAL_TERMS: {
      "zero-day": 3, "0-day": 3, "actively exploited": 3, "in the wild": 3,
      "exploited": 2, "ransomware": 2, "critical": 1, "rce": 2, "remote code execution": 2,
      "authentication bypass": 2, "patch now": 2, "emergency": 2, "out-of-band": 2,
      "cve-": 1, "australia": 2, "australian": 2, "msp": 2, "mssp": 2, "rmm": 2,
      "supply chain": 1, "phishing": 1, "data breach": 1
    },
    MIN_SCORE: 3,                 // article is "relevant" at or above this
    NEWS_MAX_AGE_DAYS: 7,         // ignore feed items older than this (MSRC feed returns its whole history)
    KEV_LOOKBACK_DAYS: 14,        // on first run, only notify about KEV entries this recent

    // CVE Watch / enrichment (TI 04, TI 05)
    NVD_API_KEY: "YOUR-NVD-API-KEY",   // https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key
    CVSS_MIN: 7.0,                     // CVE Watch keeps CVEs at or above this base score
    CVE_LOOKBACK_HOURS: 48,            // NVD publication window per run
    ENRICH_BATCH: 60,                  // KEV rows enriched per TI 05 run

    // AI summaries (Claude). Credential "Anthropic account" is selected on the Claude nodes.
    AI_ENABLED: true,
    AI_MODEL: "claude-haiku-5-5",
    AI_MAX_PER_RUN: 25,
    AI_CONTEXT: "We are an Australian MSSP running Microsoft 365/Defender XDR/Sentinel/Entra, Fortinet (FortiGate/FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer), ConnectWise and NinjaOne RMM, CrowdStrike Falcon, Proofpoint, ThreatLocker, Nessus and Auvik across ~50 SMB client tenants."
  }
}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').first().json.AI_MODEL, max_tokens: 900, thinking: { type: 'disabled' }, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}
